The hotel features 58 luxurious rooms, elegantly designed with modern interiors and professional service. Guests can unwind at Rendez-vous Lounge & Café, enjoying premium Vietnamese coffee, afternoon tea with pastries, and dishes inspired by the flavors of Hanoi. As the sun sets, the Oriental Sky Bar & Restaurant on the rooftop offers the perfect spot to admire the Old Quarter’s dazzling skyline, savor creative cocktails and delicious cuisine, and soak in the sparkling, inspiring ambiance of Hanoi by night. Hung Do I love Golden Silk Boutique Hotel because staying here alone already offers a complete experience. In the afternoon, you can join a cooking class; in the evening, head up to the rooftop to watch the sunset and the city lights at night; and the next morning, enjoy a refined breakfast. Especially, at the Ground Floor, there’s Rendez-vous Lounge & Café — a perfect spot to meet business partners, work, or simply enjoy an elegant afternoon tea set with beautifully presented pastries and fresh fruits. Erik P A dinner at Oriental Restaurant left a lasting impression on me. The menu offers a wide variety of both Vietnamese and international dishes. I chose Hanoi fresh spring rolls, grilled pork with vermicelli, and a modern-style dessert. Every dish was beautifully presented and delicious — perfectly balancing tradition and creativity. The restaurant’s elegant yet cozy atmosphere, along with the prompt and friendly service, made the dining experience truly complete. Jackson T The hotel is clean and conveniently located in the city center, making it easy to get around. I’m a regular guest here and always enjoy my stay. The staff are friendly and attentive. Since I’m older, they kindly help me carry my luggage and even assist me crossing the street. Especially Ms. Loan at the reception — she is truly dedicated and caring toward guests. Eugene J A great hotel with a central location, making it very convenient to get around. It’s surrounded by Hoan Kiem Lake and Hanoi’s famous food streets. The hotel also offers reasonably priced Hanoi tour services. The staff are professional and welcoming. Alex O The hotel has a luxurious atmosphere and a great location near Hoan Kiem Lake. I especially love the Sky Bar on the rooftop — it’s cool and breezy in the evening, offering a panoramic view of Hanoi at night. The staff are very friendly and attentive. I’ll definitely come back again. Thanh Tran Rendez-vous Lounge & Café on the first floor has a beautiful and quiet atmosphere, with very reasonable prices. I ordered an afternoon tea set, and it was impressively generous for the price. I’ll definitely come back again soon. Duc Vu The space at Oriental Sky Bar is truly wonderful. I could watch the sunset and enjoy a stunning view of the whole city from up there. The drinks were delicious and reasonably priced. As night falls, the city looks even more beautiful. Kimberly U The hotel has a great location, which is very convenient for my business trip. The staff were helpful and provided good advice. Peter at the lobby was easy to talk to. The lobby is spacious and nicely designed, and the Sky Bar on the rooftop is a wonderful place to sit and relax — many foreign guests also come here. I’m very satisfied with my stay. Quinnie S I stayed at Golden Silk Boutique Hotel for a few days and was very satisfied. The room was clean, the bed comfortable, and the space quiet despite being right in the heart of the Old Quarter. The staff were always friendly — from the quick check-in process to their attentiveness with even the smallest requests. I especially appreciated that the hotel has both a restaurant and a rooftop bar, offering a complete experience without needing to go far.
